_exclusion_reasons.timestamp: block.timestamp is used on purpose for validity windows (CA/issuer validFrom..validUntil), proposal TTL and upgrade delay (ADR-0055), daily quota buckets and publishedAt skew. QBFT validators can shift a block time by seconds; every window is hours to years long, so the drift is not exploitable. Many hits are enum comparisons inside functions that also read a timestamp field.
_exclusion_reasons.incorrect-equality: Every hit is an equality on an enum status (NONE/ACTIVE/...) or a zero sentinel (queuedAt == 0). The detector targets equality on balances or timestamps that an attacker can steer; none of these can be steered.
_exclusion_reasons.naming-convention: __gap and __TamgaRegistryBase_init follow the OpenZeppelin upgradeable convention (storage gap, onlyInitializing init function).
_exclusion_reasons.unused-state: __gap arrays are reserved storage for UUPS upgrades (SPEC-BC-0001 §9); they are unused by design and checked by contracts:storage-check.
_exclusion_reasons.costly-loop: Counter updates inside loops run only in initialize (founders, initial anchorers), bounded by the caller's array and executed once.
_exclusion_reasons.cyclomatic-complexity: Governance.execute and SchemaRegistry.registerSchema are flat dispatch/validation functions (one branch per proposal kind or field rule); splitting them would not reduce risk. Covered branch by branch in tests.
